summary: A great Blitz topic with real surprises, but in classic the famous empires (Roman, Ottoman, Byzantine) all cost lives, and a few aliases are broken.
reasons: Casual player gets British, Mongol, Russian, Spanish and French, then burns 4 lives on Roman, Ottoman, Byzantine and Holy Roman; Qing, the caliphates, Yuan and the US are stretch answers.
Blitz is deep and forgiving: almost any empire a player knows scores (15 of 21 in the casual run).
Common names miss: Persian Empire, Persia, Japanese Empire and Soviet Union are not recognized at all.
fixes: Empire of Brazil and Empire of Japan carry junk aliases split from the name: 'Empire', 'of Brazil', 'of Japan'. Drop them.
Xiongnu appears twice: #11 'Xiongnu Empire' (9.0) and #44 'Xiongnu' (3.5, alias 'Western Xiongnu'). Typing 'xiongnu' matches #44, not #11. Rename #44 to 'Western Xiongnu' and give 'Xiongnu' to #11.
Add 'Persian Empire', 'Persia' and 'Persian' as aliases of Achaemenid Empire (#20).
Add 'Japanese Empire' and 'Imperial Japan' as aliases of Empire of Japan (#13).
British Empire aliases 'British occupation' and 'British Asia' are redirects, not names of the empire; drop them.
